decisions.reason: As a core industrial inkjet printer closely tied to the firm's hardware base and in-house R&D, it is likely to remain in the portfolio despite normal lifecycle risk.
This coder extends the firm's proven marking offer to non-absorbent surfaces and fits its strategy of broad application coverage for industrial customers.
The decoding app supports the firm's move toward digitalization and traceability, though software tools face somewhat higher replacement and bundling risk than core equipment.
An inline code verification system is strongly aligned with compliance, serialization and end-to-end traceability, making it a natural product to keep.

Print layout design software complements the firm's one-stop marking solutions and common operation approach, but software modules can be refreshed or folded into broader platforms more easily than hardware.
